notes.title: Update v.0.1.02
notes.content:
Dear followers!

I've updated the game to version 0.1.02, let's see what's changed:

-I've added a 3 round cooldown to all active skills
-I've increased the level limit from 25 to 100
-I've reduced the starting amount of money, making a bit harder to get the best weapons
-I've reduced the increase/decrease steps for the "stamina" attribute from 5 to 2, making a bit harder to reach "more than enough" stamina for the fight
-I've expanded the tracklist with 7 new songs, so the background music will be a bit less repetitive
-I've fixed a bug, which let the AI do one more attack, even if the "bleeding" effect reduced his/her health to 0 in the round

For bug reports, suggestions, feedback (or anything else), please head to the Community Hub and tell me what's in your mind. It'll help me to improve the game. Thank you!

Don't forget to follow me on any of these:

Instagram:
https://www.instagram.com/forever.young.games/

Facebook:
https://www.facebook.com/ForeverYoungGames/

Twitter:
https://twitter.com/ForeverYoungGa1

Have a nice weekend,
Mark
